page_title: FIO 3-0 SAL | Fiorentina v Salernitana 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Paride Tremolada has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) but poses no threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Benoit Costil comes off his line to gather the ball.

87' Fiorentina slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
84' Paride Tremolada blows for a foul after Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jovane (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch for Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
81' Total attempts – 20:10.
79' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
77' It looks like Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Paride Tremolada won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
75' Good movement by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
73' A substitution has been made. Antonio Candreva is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
73' Here is a change. Riccardo Sottil is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina).
73' Substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jonathan Ikone walks off.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
70' Salernitana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
66' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
64' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) replacing Lucas Beltran.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alfred Duncan as he is replaced by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
63' Here comes a substitution. Luca Ranieri is given a rest as he is replaced by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina).
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
58' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to substitute Lassana Coulibaly and he is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emil Bohinen leaves the pitch and Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) comes on.

56' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Riccardo Sottil plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
52' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
48' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' Half-time substitution. Filippo Inzaghi decided to make a change. Grigoris Kastanos is replaced by Boulaye Dia (Salernitana).
46' Referee Paride Tremolada blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Paride Tremolada didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
39' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
36' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
34' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paride Tremolada has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
32' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
26' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
23' A cross from Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
20' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' 2 - 0 Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) collects a wonderful pass and fires a strong shot towards the top right corner which ricochets in off the post.
16' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
16' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
14' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana).
10' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
8' The referee blows his whistle after Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Benoit Costil to commit before slotting the penalty into the top left corner.
6' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
4' Poor challenge! Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is penalised for tripping and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Fiorentina!
3' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Paride Tremolada is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
